# Falling [Hazard]

*[Rules Glossary](../../index.md) > [Exploration > Hazards](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#FallingHazard)*

A creature that falls takes 1d6 Bludgeoning damage at the end of the fall for every 10 feet it fell, to a maximum of 20d6. When the creature lands, it has the [Prone](../../Conditions/Prone.md) condition unless it avoids taking any damage from the fall.

A creature that falls into water or another liquid can use its [Reaction](../../Combat/Actions/Reaction.md) to make a DC 15 Strength ([Athletics](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/free-rules/playing-the-game#Skills)) or Dexterity ([Acrobatics](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/free-rules/playing-the-game#Skills)) check to hit the surface head or feet first. On a successful check, any damage resulting from the fall is halved.
